description:
Operator follow-up promoted from nightly-throughput-gate-restoration w3. Dispatch a workflow_dispatch nightly run and confirm the throughput-uat job passes green now that continue-on-error is removed and strict per-stream success gating is on (#1231). Record the run URL.

PREMISE FALSIFIED 2026-08-24. The run was dispatched (nightly run 32684255652, workflow_dispatch on develop) and throughput-uat FAILED. It is not green.

The job's own assertion step reports:
  ::error::No throughput UAT result JSON found for duckdb/tpch

So the failure is upstream of the per-stream success gating this item was written to confirm -- the run produces no result JSON for the assertion to read at all. That is a different problem from the one #1231 fixed, and this item should not be closed by re-dispatching until it is understood.

Note it was NOT in the failure list of the 2026-08-23 scheduled run (32622645993), whose Windows and ubuntu-3.10 failures I triaged in nightly-red-blocks-release-evidence w2. So throughput-uat is either newly broken between 08-23 and 08-24, or intermittent. Both readings are worth distinguishing before fixing.

Blocks nightly-red-blocks-release-evidence w4.

EVIDENCE CORRECTION 2026-08-25: PR #1871 head was e87fa89a127798cf223b795ac83f68937057bc79 and merge commit was f751867169769c47f991c531f39df6025b9ae976. The w2 text used the head SHA after the words merged as; this note preserves the immutable work-unit audit record while correcting the label.

work_units.evidence: Root cause identified: PR #1815 (8d9d09ff6) refactored resolve_official_result_path to require emitted_path (returning None when omitted), but .github/workflows/nightly.yml was not updated and called resolve_official_result_path without emitted_path.
work_units.summary: Find why the throughput-uat run emits no result JSON for duckdb/tpch

work_units.evidence: Confirmed: New since 2026-08-23. Introduced by PR #1815 merged on 2026-08-23 22:39 UTC (after the 2026-08-23 06:19 UTC scheduled run).
work_units.summary: Establish whether this is new since 2026-08-23 or intermittent
